accordions.Product Description: It features a silky emollient blend for easy spreading and even application. Smooth hydrating finish with a staying power of 8 hrs.
accordions.How to use it?: Start With Cleansed, Moisturised Skin. Apply Dots Of Foundation To Forehead, Cheeks, Nose, And Chin. Blend With Fingertips, Brush, Or Sponge Until You Achieve The Desired Matte-Look Foundation Finish. Layer As Needed For Extra Coverage, Perfect For Touch-Ups On Uneven Skin Tone Or For An Extra Boost Of Confidence.
accordions.Ingredients: High-performance silicone system: Caprylyl Methicone  5% Dimethicone  3.6% Cyclopentasiloxane  3.6% Trimethylsiloxysilicate  3% Polymethylsilsesquioxane  3% Blurring Powder System Silica  3.9% Formulated with a high-performance silicone system for a smooth, lightweight glide. Infused with silica to help absorb excess oil and create a soft-focus matte finish. Film-forming system: Trimethylsiloxysilicate  3% Acrylates/Dimethicone Copolymer  0.4% Powered by film-forming ingredients to help improve makeup wear and skin adherence. Moisturizing ingredients: Glycerin  4.5% Dipropylene Glycol  4% Sorbitol  0.14% Sodium Hyaluronate  0.03% Balanced with moisturizing ingredients to support a comfortable matte finish. Silky emollient blend: Isotridecyl Isononanoate  4% Pentaerythrityl Tetraethylhexanoate  3% Isostearyl Isostearate  2.5% Cetyl Dimethicone  0.85% Features a silky emollient blend for easy spreading and even application.
accordions.Key Benefits: Designed with blurring powders to help refine the look of pores and skin texture. Engineered for a smooth, lightweight, non-heavy feel on skin. Crafted to combine oil control, blurring, and comfortable wear in one formula.

accordions.Product Description: The experience is skin-friendly, comfort paired with intense, high-pigment color that stays vibrant all long.
accordions.How to use it?: Dab the bristles of your brush on the product lightly and dust off any excess. Sweep the brush lightly over the areas of your face you would like to apply the blush. Remember to start with little and work your way up for more pigment.
accordions.Ingredients: Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, hydrogenated polyisobutene, synthetic squalane, it has the characteristics of squalane such as strong water retention, moisturizing, easy absorption, and antioxidant properties, while avoiding the drawback of natural squalane which needs to be extracted from animal body parts. Talc (talcum powder), Mica (mica) are processed with Dimethicone (polydimethylsiloxane), and the product will be more skin-friendly and long-lasting after application.

accordions.Product Description: Crafted to combine gloss, radiance, and elegant shimmer in one formula.
accordions.How to use it?: Infused with light-reflecting shimmer for an instant radiant glow. Delivers a silky, luminous finish that leaves your skin glowing all day. A body highlighter oil is meant to be applied on points of your body to get a luminous sheen. Avoid applying face highlighter makeup on areas of your body that have acne scars or bumps as it can make them more prominent.
accordions.Ingredients: Emollient oil blend: Mineral Oil <55% Ethylhexyl Palmitate <40% Formulated with an emollient oil blend for smooth glide, easy spreading, and a glossy skin finish. Texture-enhancing gel network: Hydrogenated Styrene/Isoprene Copolymer <6% Silica Dimethyl Silylate <5% Designed with a texture-enhancing gel network to create a cushiony feel, improve shimmer suspension, and support even application. Radiance-enhancing mineral and pearl system: Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891) <4% Synthetic Fluorphlogopite <3% Silica <1% Tin Oxide <0.1% Infused with light-reflective minerals and pearl pigments to create a luminous, multidimensional glow effect on skin.
accordions.Key Benefits: Designed to deliver a radiant, light-catching body glow. Features a silky oil texture for smooth spreading and even payoff. Engineered for a smooth, comfortable, skin-enhancing finish. Crafted to combine gloss, radiance, and elegant shimmer in one formula.

accordions.Product Description: Smooth texture, hydrating matte Orchid Lipstick, with a beautiful floral petals and birds design on the bullet, staying power min 8 hrs
accordions.How to use it?: Prep your lips with lip balm for high moisture and better results Apply Directly From The Bullet For An Even Finish, Or Use A Lip Brush For Precision. Build Layers For A More Intense Colour Payoff.
accordions.Ingredients: Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer: This is a cross-linked polymer composed of dimethicone and vinyl dimethicone. It makes the lipstick application smoother and matte, providing excellent matte shading and blurring effects. It can also have a physical effect of reducing lip wrinkles. Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil: This is a natural plant oil derived from the seeds of jojoba (SIMMONDSIA CHINENSIS). Its structure is similar to human sebum and is easily absorbed, providing moisturization and hydration to the lips, and is very gentle.
